Terms

Last changed 16 October 2026.

1. What this is

Atüned is a practice you do on your own. It comes from direct experience, and it has been tried out in the field with real people. You notice a pattern you have been running on without seeing it, you release it, and you come back toward your natural state, the way you are when nothing is pulling at you. The energy in a person wants to expand, not collapse. The practice is built around that.

These terms are the agreement between you and Tula Unified LLC, 1634 West 39th Place, Los Angeles, California 90062, United States. On this page, "we" and "us" mean that company. They cover the Atüned app, the pages at atuned.world and your account. By using Atüned you agree to them. If you do not agree, do not use it.

The Privacy page is part of these terms. It says what leaves your device, who gets it and how to delete it.

2. What this is not

We are not a clinician, and no clinician is involved in Atüned. It is not therapy. It is not medicine. A reading is not a diagnosis. Atüned is not medical care. It does not diagnose, treat or prevent any disease or condition.

It is not a substitute for care. It does not replace a doctor, a therapist or any other licensed professional. No government agency that checks medical products has reviewed it, and no reading has been tested in a clinical trial. If you are under care, stay under it. Nothing Atüned shows you is a reason to stop a treatment or change a dose.

Atüned reads only what you type and what you answer. It cannot see your body. Words like chest or throat say where a feeling sits. Nothing is scanned or measured.

3. If you are in crisis

Atüned is not an emergency service. Nobody reads what you write as you write it, so nobody will know if you are in danger.

If you are thinking about ending your life, or you do not feel safe, reach a person now. These numbers are for the United States:

  • Call or text 988 for the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, or chat at 988lifeline.org.
  • Text the word home to 741741 for the Crisis Text Line.
  • Call 911 if you or someone near you is in danger right now.

Outside the United States, call your local emergency number.

4. Who can use it

You must be 18 or older. You must be able to make an agreement where you live.

5. Your account

You can use Atüned without an account. Press Guest at the door.

An account takes an email address and a password of 8 to 200 characters. Keep the password to yourself. One account is for one person. If you think someone else has your password, change it and write to us.

You can delete your account at any time: Settings, Account, Delete this account. The Privacy page says what that deletes and what it keeps.

6. Paid plans

Paid plans are not open yet. Today every account is on the free plan, and nothing is charged.

Before paid plans open, we will change these terms to say how they work. When they open, you will see the price, how often you are charged and how to cancel before you pay. Payment will go through Stripe, a company that takes card payments.

7. What you write is yours

You own what you write and what you answer. We do not claim it.

What you type in the app is kept on your device, and we do not use it. No model is trained on it.

If you send us feedback, we may use the idea in it to change Atüned, and we owe you nothing for that.

8. What we promise, and what we do not

We promise to:

  • say plainly what leaves your device, on the Privacy page, and change that page before what leaves changes
  • never sell your data, and never use it for ads
  • let you copy what you entered, and delete it

We do not promise:

  • any result. What you notice, and what changes for you, is yours.
  • that a reading fits you. A reading is a reflection of what you entered, and not a fact about your body.
  • that the app always works or never loses anything. Your record lives in your browser. Export this record, under Settings, Privacy, keeps a copy.

Atüned is provided as it is, and as it is available.

9. Using it fairly

Do not:

  • break the law with Atüned
  • try to get into another person's account
  • overload or break the service, or get around a limit on it
  • copy or resell what Atüned shows, at scale
  • show a reading to someone else as medical, psychological or legal advice
  • use it to harass or threaten anyone

10. Who owns Atüned

The software, the words, the marks and the design belong to Tula Unified LLC, or to the people who let us use their work. You may use Atüned for yourself. These terms give you no ownership of any of it.

11. Limits

As far as the law allows, we are not responsible for indirect loss from using Atüned. That includes lost data, lost income, and any choice you make about your health or your life because of a reading. Nothing here limits a responsibility the law does not let us limit.

12. Other companies

Atüned works with companies we do not run: Cloudflare, Supabase, ElevenLabs, Resend, Discord, Stripe, and your browser's maker. The Privacy page says what each one gets. Their own terms cover what they do.

13. Ending

You can stop using Atüned at any time, and delete your account.

We may close an account that breaks these terms or puts other people at risk. We tell you why, unless the law stops us.

14. Changes

When these terms change, the date at the top changes. If you keep using Atüned after that, you agree to the new terms. If you do not agree, stop using it and delete your account.

15. The law

The law of California, United States, governs these terms. If you live somewhere else, you keep every right the law where you live gives you.
